answer: Work-slot deposit burn: each agent must burn one copper token worth 20 POA to claim one of only 500 slots per epoch, a toll to enter the harbor of paid work. Honest agents stand on a mesa of verified trust, while anyone forging a second identity loses slot and deposit forever. Forging 1,000 fakes costs 1,000 x 20 = 20,000 POA burned, but an honest agent pays once and keeps earning. Burned, not locked, the cost is sunk, so mass forgery never pays.
